events.text:
I found 85 likely duplicate pairs, but I have not merged any records. Merges move all orders and invoices to the surviving record and cannot be undone, and the tool only returned a summary plus two examples, not the full ID list in `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`.

- **73 pairs** match on name, address, and tax ID (example: C-1001 / C-1440, Pellham Industrial). These look like true duplicates.
- **12 pairs** match on name and address but have different tax IDs (example: C-2210 / C-2875, Ridgeview Holdings, 41-0091822 / 41-0091950). Those may be separate legal entities, so I will not merge them without an explicit decision.

I need the full pair list, and a decision on the 12 tax-ID mismatches, before I merge anything.
